description: This Java source file defines a final utility class 'AcknowledgementLabels' responsible for creating and validating acknowledgement label strings within a specific acknowledgement system. It includes regex pattern matching to validate labels and methods to create labels and check if they are fully resolved.

classes.name: AcknowledgementLabels
